entries.title: A card's thread stays open on your iPhone when the card changes
entries.body: When you are reading a card's thread on your iPhone or iPad and the card is updated, the card no longer turns back to its front on its own. A small dot on the Card button at the top of the thread tells you the card changed, and Card turns it over to show the new version.
entries.noPicture: The change is on the iPhone and iPad card, and the turn it removes is motion that a still picture of the Mac cannot show.
